credentialBoundary.required: fine-grained PAT or GitHub App user access token

plans.name: llmops-stale-policy-review
steps: Proceed only when the Azure Monitor alert title or alertRule contains the case-sensitive rule name llmops-live-stale-policy. Stop if it does not match or if the evidence is not from live mode.

Investigate Azure in read-only mode. Correlate the Application Insights trace, verify the current Container App revision only to rule out a platform failure, and inspect Activity Log only when the trace indicates a platform or configuration change. Collect at most three direct evidence items and never execute an Azure write operation.

Build the strict broker payload with no free-form public text: mode=live; alert_id copied exactly from the Azure Monitor incident card for broker-side Managed Identity verification and never published; alert_rule=llmops-live-stale-policy; one to three evidence_codes chosen only from superseded_policy_selected, model_call_succeeded, and container_revision_healthy; one to three ruled_out_codes; root_cause_code=stale_policy_filter_missing; and confidence_band. Set investigation_fingerprint to the first 12 lowercase hexadecimal characters of SHA-256 over alert_rule|root_cause_code|comma-separated evidence_codes sorted lexically. The broker recomputes it and generates all public prose from server-side templates. Omit every other trace ID, resource ID, raw telemetry, prompt or output content, customer data, credentials, tokens, and connection strings.

Call only github-handoff-broker_submit_incident_handoff once with the strict payload. The broker, not SRE Agent, performs the idempotent repository-scoped GitHub issue creation and official Copilot assignment. Never call a GitHub write tool directly.

If the broker returns copilot_assigned or copilot_already_assigned, call only github-handoff-broker_get_handoff_status with the returned issue_number at intervals of at least 30 seconds for at most 10 minutes. Report draft_pr_ready only when the broker returns a verified pull_request_url and pull_request_is_draft=true. If the broker returns incomplete, stop immediately. A timeout remains an incomplete asynchronous handoff, not success.

Do not create or edit repository files directly, merge a pull request, deploy, trigger a workflow, modify Azure, enable automatic Azure remediation, or represent missing evidence, an uncreated issue, an unassigned Copilot task, or an uncreated pull request as success.
plans.escalation: If live evidence is unavailable, broker validation fails, the broker is not configured, or a draft pull request is not verified within 10 minutes, stop and leave the incident incomplete for human review. Never substitute simulation evidence.
